horned spiders.desc:
Two large spiders covered in gray hair stares at you with 6 evil red eyes.
They are as big as you are and their mandibles are thicker than your arms.
You are having a hard time just standing still.
Your brain is telling you to run, but it is too late. You can't run from these.

two feral humans.desc:
Two feral women wearing rags engage you.
It observes you carefully, as if hunting an animal.

Sparring Cobby.desc:
It's Cobby.
He is wielding a sparring stick.
He is way bulkier than you and will destroy you if you make him mad.

Teaching Cobby.desc:
Cobby: [Alright. Let me teach you about targeting. Tap on this text area to access the targeting options.]

Cobby: [You'll see the option to target me, followed by my health status. When you are facing more than one enemy, you will have a better use for this mode.
Anyways, let's continue sparring. Hit me.]

three ants.desc:
Ants with the size of a toddler crawl towards you.
They constantly wiggle their long antennae on their heads.
Ants are usually not too aggressive, but these seem to be startled by your presence.

millipede.desc: A worm-like monster with countless legs slithers its way to you.

pill bug.desc: An armored bug shaped like an uncurled ball crawls towards you.

caterpillar.desc:
A fat worm with fabulous hair crawls toward you.
You probably don't want to touch that.

two bloodquitos.desc:
Two flying insect monsters bigger than your head are flying toward you.
Their giant blood red eyes are staring at you with malice, and their transparent wings flap slowly at their sides.
Six lanky legs stick forward, shivering with excitement for blood.
These are the infamous Bloodquitos - they can and will drink you dry!

three bloodquitos.desc:
Three flying insect monsters bigger than your head are flying toward you.
Their giant blood red eyes are staring at you with malice, and their transparent wings flap slowly at their sides.
Six lanky legs stick forward, shivering with excitement for blood.
These are the infamous Bloodquitos - they can and will drink you dry!

bloodquito.desc:
A bloodquito is flying toward you, its giant blood red eyes fixed on you with malice.
Its transparent wings flap slowly at its sides, and its lanky legs shiver with excitement for blood.
It can and will drink you dry!

centipede.desc:
A monster with numerous segments of bodies and legs crawls toward you.
Its huge mandibles will make sure you won't get out of here in one piece.

two ticks.desc:
Two tiny blood red ticks crawl toward you.
They are slow to move, but will suck your blood dry if you let them too close.
They are filled with blood and will explode in your face on death.

moth.desc:
A giant winged beast slowly flaps its wings toward you.
Every time it flaps its huge wings, green particles scatter out from its wing hair.

squirrel.desc:
A mean looking beast with a tail taller than you.
Not very aggressive, but still pretty hard to kill.

yellow butterfly.desc:
A giant monster with wings bigger than you slowly flaps its wings as it descends.
Its extremely long proboscis looks pretty sharp.

three fire ants.desc:
Three fire ants with the size of a toddler crawl towards you.
These fire ants look much more aggressive compared to normal ants.

bee.desc:
A yellow bumble bee flies toward you.
It's cute looking.

bee and bloodquito.desc:
A cute yellow bumble bee flies toward you.
It's brought a friend.

beetle.desc:
A giant blue beetle with a beautiful large horn is grazing on the field.
It looks uninterested in you, but you insist on fighting it.
It sighs and confronts you.

feral hunters.desc:
A group of feral humans wielding chitin spears approach you with malicious intent.
They do not seem to understand you.

horned spider.desc:
A large spider covered in gray hair crawls toward you.
It is as big as you are and its mandibles are thicker than your arms.
It's unnaturally large horn on its head suggest its unnatural origin.
You are having a hard time just standing still.

henge guards.desc:
A Stone Henge guard in full chitin armor equipped with a chitin shield and chitin mace blocks your way. Behind him are two Stone Henge scouts with bows ready to shoot you down.
They look pretty disciplined.

henge shaman.desc: A Stone Henge guard wearing a strange leather robe blocks your way. He is wielding a glowing staff.

rat.desc:
A ferocious beast bigger than you with huge front teeth approach you.
Rats are dangerous predators that can charge and shred you in seconds. Beware!

rotting pile.desc:
You find a rotting pile of leaves and manure behind a boulder.
The rotting pile is infested with pill bugs and worms.
Some of them notice you and crawl out.

ant swarm.desc:
A swarm of ants are running for you right now.
They must've run out of things to feed their queen.

stone henge arena.desc:
You are at the training grounds.

There are many Stone Henge guards and hunters sparring in the arena.
One of the participants approach you for a fight.

ant hill priest guards.desc:
You are fighting Ant Hill guards in full chitin armor.
These familiar guards that you've seen around your whole life have never looked so threatening before...

fish.desc:
A giant dark shadow under the surface of the water approach you.
It might leap out of the water to swallow you whole!

elite feral hunters.desc: A group of feral humans wielding chitin halberds approach you fiercely. They are wearing some fancy pink leather over their shoulders that seem to represent their elite status.

feral ambushers.desc: A group of feral humans ambush you from the darkness. They probably wasn't pleased at you trying to steal their food.

feral ambushers 2.desc: A group of feral humans ambush you from the darkness. They probably wasn't pleased at you trying to steal their food.

feral ambushers 3.desc: A group of feral humans and their domesticated red ticks ambush you from the darkness. They probably didn't like you trying to steal their food.

zombies.desc: A group of bloated, burnt corpses are somehow standing on its own... It looks like they have sensed you somehow and approach you.

zombie.desc: A bloated, burnt corpse somehow standing on its own... It has sensed you and wants to eat you alive.

Cheese the hoarder.desc:
Cheese transforms into a purple shade.
He will not give up the staff that he found, and you know that you must use force to take it from him.

Sugar the hoarder.desc:
It's Sugar.
He is almost as bulky and ugly as Cobby.
He isn't open for compromise, and you know that the only way to make him move is by force.

amalgamation.desc:
This is a mound of limb and flesh forming one organism.
It is covered in algae at the top and glowing mushrooms everywhere else.

You are trembling with fear.

cliff vine.desc: A cluster of dark green vines attack you. There's some kind of rocks inside the vines, but it is covered in leaves and you can't tell just exactly what it really is.

vines.desc: A cluster of dark green vines attack you. There's some kind of rocks inside the vines, but it is covered in leaves and you can't tell just exactly what it really is.

four vines.desc: A cluster of dark green vines attack you. There's some kind of rocks inside the vines, but it is covered in leaves and you can't tell just exactly what it really is.

mass of vines.desc: A cluster of dark green vines attack you. There's some kind of rocks inside the vines, but it is covered in leaves and you can't tell just exactly what it really is.

raptors.desc: A swarm of raptors attack you. They look like overgrown chickens with large claws and vicious fangs. You've never seen these hideous creatures in your life.

ancient bug.desc: An ancient... pill bug? Does not look very threatening, but sure is big.

ancientquito.desc: An ancient... bloodquito! It's hideous, large, and sickening to watch.

highwaymen.desc:
You are surrounded by armed men up to no good.
They look like they won't hesitate to kill you.

metal rat.desc:
A giant rat-like machine made of metal pops out of some metal ball.
Its face fizzes with electricity, watch out!

thief.desc:
It's a thief!
He looks like he won't hesitate to kill you.

jericho guards.desc:
People wearing fully plated brass armor approach you.
They wear funny metal and glass artifacts on their eyes.
They look pretty disciplined.

jericho prisoners.desc:
You are facing lowlife prisoners with nothing to lose.
They are armed with pickaxes.

jericho outlaws.desc:
You are facing the outlaws of Jericho.
They wear funny goggles and make bad remarks about you.

arena 1.desc:
Broadcaster: [We have another challenger! A hunter from the frontier! Underdog or a tribute? Find out!]

You are facing an ex criminal on his second win streak.
He has fresh wounds all over his naked upper body.
He seems pretty exhausted.

arena 2.desc:
Broadcaster: [The underdog triumphs! But we have another underdog from the frontier! Dog versus dog! Who's more under?]

Pemmi: [Jeez, this broadcaster is terrible.]

Pemmi raises her crossbow and aims at you.

arena 3.desc:
Broadcaster: [The nobody boy makes it to the semi finals! Will he... WIN???]

You are facing some kind of adjoined twin.
Upon closer look, it looks like they're actually 2 people pretending to be adjoined.

arena 4.desc:
Broadcaster: [The final round! This is the 4th round, and if he makes it, he WINS IT!]

You are facing some generic bulky guy with a bald head and a ugly face.
He is completely unscathed.
He obviously looks like he was hired by the arena to stop anyone from getting the grand prize.

wounded horned spiders.desc:
Two large spiders covered in gray hair stares at you with 6 evil red eyes.
They are as big as you are and their mandibles are thicker than your arms.
Their exotically large horn suggest their unnatural origins.
They are covered in blood.

three horned spiders.desc:
Three large spiders covered in gray hair stares at you with 6 evil red eyes.
They are as big as you are and their mandibles are thicker than your arms.
Their exotically large horn suggest their unnatural origins.

large horned spider.desc:
You face a particularly large horned spider.
It looks even more vicious compared to the normal horned spiders.

guard spiders.desc:
Three particularly large horned spiders block your way.
They look even more vicious compared to normal horned spiders.
